title: FHIR R4 Observation — platform ingestion schema
description: Starter JSON Schema for the platform's Observation ingestion payload. This is not the official HL7 FHIR R4 Observation schema or a profile validator. Additional FHIR elements are permitted.

id.description: Required by the platform ingestion endpoint; used as the unique persisted resource identifier.

category.description: FHIR classification; not currently inspected by the runtime validator.

code.description: FHIR CodeableConcept; omission is a warning, but its structure is not inspected by the runtime validator.

subject.description: Optional; if supplied and non-null, must contain a string reference.

valueQuantity.description: FHIR Quantity; not currently inspected by the runtime validator.
